parsed.answer: Source [4926049] directly establishes that the shelterin protein TRF2 recruits RTEL1 to telomeres in S phase and that the TRF2-RTEL1 interaction is mediated by a metal-coordinating C4C4 motif in RTEL1. The same study shows this interaction is disrupted by the disease mutation RTEL1(R1264H) and abolished by TRF2(I124D), confirming the C4C4 motif as the binding determinant. The other two sources concern 5S rRNA assembly and IEX-1 induction and provide no relevant evidence.
